categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, design, packaging, testing, production, and sales of semiconductor memory products. Its main product lines include embedded storage, PC storage, automotive-grade storage, enterprise-level storage, and mobile storage. Additionally, it provides advanced packaging and testing services. The company also focuses on chip IC design, advanced packaging, and chip testing equipment development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs integrated R&D and packaging/testing operations, leveraging advanced packaging technologies such as 16-layer stacked die, ultra-thin die (30-40μm), multi-chip heterogeneous integration, and flip chip technology. It develops proprietary firmware algorithms, storage chip packaging processes, and testing equipment with full-stack capabilities. The manufacturing base uses automated production lines with high automation rates (up to 99% in chip packaging and 91% in module manufacturing).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading smartphone manufacturers (e.g., OPPO, Motorola, ZTE), PC OEMs (e.g., Lenovo, HP, Acer), smart wearable device makers (e.g., Google, Xiaomi, Meta), automotive Tier1 suppliers, and data center operators. The company serves markets such as mobile smart terminals, PCs, industrial terminals, data centers, smart cars, and mobile storage. It also operates in consumer, industrial, automotive, and enterprise storage segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shenzhen, Huizhou, Chengdu, and other cities. It has subsidiaries and sales operations in Hong Kong, the United States, Brazil, and other international markets. Its global sales network covers over 39 countries and regions, including North America, Latin America, India, Europe, and Taiwan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the semiconductor storage supply chain, focusing on R&D, packaging, testing, and module manufacturing. It procures NAND Flash and DRAM wafers and chips from upstream IDM manufacturers and integrates these into finished storage products. It also provides advanced packaging and testing services to other semiconductor companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes a '5+2+X' strategic framework focusing on five key application markets (mobile phones, PCs, servers, smart wearables, automotive-grade storage), two growth engines (chip design and wafer-level advanced packaging), and exploration of emerging technologies (computing-storage integration, new interfaces, new media, advanced testing equipment). It significantly increased R&D investment in chip design, storage solutions, advanced packaging, and testing equipment, aiming to become a global leader in storage and advanced packaging.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of semiconductor memory products (embedded storage, SSDs, memory modules, storage cards) and advanced packaging and testing services. The company also earns licensing fees from brand authorizations (e.g., HP, Acer, Predator) for storage products. Revenue recognition is based on delivery and customer acceptance of products and services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global semiconductor storage leaders such as Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron, Kioxia, and Western Digital. It positions itself as a leading domestic storage and advanced packaging provider with growing international presence. It holds a strong position in the domestic market with increasing penetration in global first-tier customer supply chains and is recognized for its integrated R&D and packaging capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.59 billion, representing a 20.27% year-over-year increase. However, it reported a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 624 million due to industry downturns and increased R&D and stock-based compensation expenses. Total assets grew by 43.55% to RMB 6.33 billion. The company is in a growth phase with significant investment in R&D and production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes integrated R&D and packaging/testing capabilities, enabling rapid product innovation, customization, and quality control. It offers a comprehensive product portfolio covering various storage types and application scenarios with advanced technology features such as low power consumption, high reliability, small form factor, and high performance. Its strategic partnerships with global CPU/SoC vendors and brand authorizations enhance its market credibility and customer reach. The company also focuses on advanced packaging technologies like wafer-level packaging to support next-generation AI and high-performance computing applications.
